Hello? Can you hear me? There's so much I've written but

Will it be good?

o x o o
o o o o

Will it be good?

But what if it means nothing? What should I do if none of it means a thing? What if it means nothing?

o o o x
o o o o
What if it means nothing?

When did I write this, and how did the book get here filled with my own words? How did it get here filled with my own thoughts? How can I tell if any of what I did meant anything? Will I die without knowing?
Will I die without knowing?

o o o o
x o o o

All these questions, all these words, asking how you can know how you can ever know if anything you ever wrote was good. How can you be sure? You can't be sure. If you have to be sure don't write.
